name: Omarchy Browser
summary: The browser built for Omarchy, with the store built in
description:
What's new in 2.0: your Omarchy theme applied live, tracker shield, workspaces, split view, reader with local AI summaries, a command palette, and the store panel now knows what is already installed.

Omarchy Browser is a Chromium browser built for Omarchy. It looks like your desktop, keeps trackers out, and has the Omarchy Store right next to your page.

YOUR THEME, LIVE
• Uses the colors of your current Omarchy theme for the whole browser
• Switch themes and the browser follows in under two seconds
• New tab page and reader view are themed too

THE STORE, RIGHT NEXT TO YOUR PAGE
• Press Store (or Ctrl+B) to open the Omarchy Store in a side panel
• Sees which apps are already on your computer: Open instead of Get
• Browse any GitHub repo that is in the store and a one-click Get pops up
• Search any app and press Get; the full store page is one click away

SHIELD
• Blocks the tracking and ad networks that do most of the tracking
• Live counter in the address bar shows what was blocked on this page
• One click turns it off; sends Do Not Track and Global Privacy Control

WORKSPACES AND SPLIT VIEW
• Separate tab sets for work, play and projects (Ctrl+Shift+W)
• Everything comes back when you relaunch
• Two pages side by side with Ctrl+\

READER WITH SUMMARIZE
• Clean reading view for any article (Ctrl+Shift+R), with font and size controls
• Summarize: a local AI model if Ollama is on your computer, otherwise a built-in summary
• Nothing is sent anywhere; it all runs on your machine

COMMAND PALETTE
• Ctrl+K: commands, open tabs, store apps, bookmarks, history and web search in one box
• Type > for commands, @ for apps, / for tabs

A REAL CHROMIUM BROWSER
• Address bar suggestions from your history and bookmarks
• Find in page, per-site zoom, downloads panel, right-click menu with Open in split view
• Mouse back and forward buttons, Ctrl+1 to 9 for tabs
• Stays signed in to your sites between launches
• Choose DuckDuckGo, Google, Brave or Bing for search

SAFE INSTALLS
• Get uses Omarchy's own installer, in a terminal you can see
• You type your own password: the browser never sees it
• Only apps listed in the Omarchy Store can be installed

Tiny download: it uses the Chromium engine already on your computer. Free and open source (MIT), from Omarchy Development Labs.

featured.headline: The browser built for Omarchy.
featured.tagline: Your theme, live. Trackers blocked. The world's largest app store for Omarchy, one keypress away. Open a project on GitHub and Get it right there. A reader that sums up any page, on your machine. Ctrl+K and everything is one box away.

features.title: Your theme, live
features.body: Change your Omarchy theme and the browser changes with it in under two seconds. Chrome, new tab page and reader all use your colors.

features.title: The store, next to your page
features.body: Press Store or Ctrl+B. Browse, search, see what is already on your computer, press Get. Open a GitHub repo that is in the store and a one-click Get pops up.

features.title: Shield
features.body: Tracker and ad blocking with a live counter in the address bar. One click turns it off for a page.

features.title: Workspaces and split view
features.body: Separate tab sets for work and play that come back on relaunch. Put two pages side by side with Ctrl+\\.

features.title: Reader with Summarize
features.body: Clean reading view for any article. Summarize uses a local model if Ollama is on your computer, otherwise a built-in summary. Nothing leaves your machine.

features.title: Command palette
features.body: Ctrl+K: commands, open tabs, store apps, bookmarks, history and web search in one box.

steps.title: Press GET
steps.body: The store downloads Omarchy Browser, checks it's genuine and installs it. You confirm with your password.

steps.title: Open Omarchy Browser
steps.body: Press Super + Space and type Omarchy Browser. It already looks like your desktop.

steps.title: Press Ctrl+K
steps.body: Type what you want: a site, a command, or an app from the store.

changelog.title: The big one
changelog.body: Theme follows Omarchy live, tracker shield, workspaces, split view, reader with local AI summaries, command palette, address bar suggestions, downloads panel, store-aware GitHub banner, Installed detection in the store panel.

changelog.title: New look
items: A new icon made from the official Omarchy logo.
Omarchy Browser now shows up in the dock and the app list as soon as it's installed.
The store panel shows the Omarchy Store's own icon.
App descriptions with symbols like & now read correctly.

changelog.title: Omarchy Browser is here
items: A fast Chromium browser made for Omarchy, with tabs, search and an address bar.
The Omarchy Store is built in: press Store or Ctrl+B to open it next to your page.
Press GET in the store panel to install an app with Omarchy's own installer.
Links that open new windows open as new tabs instead.
